payload.title: CarFight Content Catalog & Authoring System / 콘텐츠 카탈로그·제작 시스템
payload.next_action: Correct CCAS-P0-06 blocking P1 exact6 in ContentAuthoringSystemPlan.md v0.1.11, then run a fresh Design Re-review before any implementation. Freeze: immutable Catalog Snapshot + fingerprint; Weapon Roster planning metadata fidelity; explicit Active/Deprecated/Retired lifecycle; Change Set semantic legality and bulk-conflict rules; per-record rationale + immutable Review Package/approval binding; planning stale guard across Workbook/Product/Resource/Provider state. Preserve the existing no-direct-DataAsset-write boundary and require Product Provider.ApplyReviewed/SavePackage/Product mutation/rename-move-delete exact0 in P0-06. Do not start Workbook/DataAsset authoring, CCAS mutation implementation, Product Apply/Save, or P0-07 authority cutover.
blockers: P1-1 Immutable Catalog Snapshot contract missing
P1-2 Weapon Roster planning metadata fidelity incomplete
P1-3 Canonical Retire lifecycle storage contract missing
P1-4 Change Set semantic legality and bulk-conflict rules incomplete
P1-6 Planning stale guard does not yet bind non-Workbook truth

provenance.resolution_basis: Fresh CCAS-P0-06 Pre-Implementation Design Review against ContentAuthoringSystemPlan.md v0.1.10, USER Accepted WeaponContentRosterPlan.md v0.1.1, and current CFContentTypes/Compiler/Provider contracts found P0 exact0, blocking P1 exact6, and P2 exact3. Existing P0-01~05 accepted foundations remain reusable: typed Change Set shape, WorkbookSemanticHash, read-only CompilePreview, dependency/impact analysis, retire candidate preview and no-Apply compiler guard. Blocking gaps are limited to the P0-06 planning/review layer: immutable Catalog Snapshot identity, exact preservation of roster planning metadata, explicit canonical retire lifecycle, semantic validation/conflict rules for bulk operations, per-record rationale plus immutable review/approval binding, and stale planning checks covering Product/Resource/Provider truth beyond Workbook hash. No-direct-DA-write structure is accepted and must remain exact0 for Product mutation in P0-06. Implementation and Product authoring remain unopened.
